description: This file defines the SceneSet class, which implements a plugin interface for managing application scenes within the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for configuration and notification handling, and declares methods for initialization, deinitialization, and handling app lifecycle state changes.

classes.name: SceneSet
classes.description: A plugin class that manages application scenes and handles app lifecycle notifications within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: SceneSet::Configuration
classes.description: A nested class representing the configuration container for the SceneSet plugin, holding the reference application name.

classes.name: SceneSet::NotificationHandler
classes.description: A nested class implementing the notification interface to handle app lifecycle state changes and forward them to the parent SceneSet instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SceneSet plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the SceneSet plugin, performing cleanup.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in application lifecycle state, invoked by the notification handler.

methods.name: StartReferenceApp
methods.description: Starts the reference application (implementation not shown).

methods.name: MonitorReferenceAppCrash
methods.description: Monitors the reference application's crash status (implementation not shown).

methods.name: RestartReferenceApp
methods.description: Restarts the reference application after a crash (implementation not shown).
